en: Colorized illustration of a large stone public building on a street corner, likely early-20th‑century. The structure has light grey brick or stone walls with tall narrow windows, steep red-tile roofs, and several volumes at different heights, including a rounded dome-like roof on one section. A coat of arms is visible high on the main gabled façade. Streetlamps and leafy trees frame the foreground, and the sky shows a soft gradient suggesting sunset or sunrise. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
